goal: Hotspot and claim binding in frontend ArtDetailStudioClient.tsx and backend routers
summary: Implemented 3D hotspot coordinates linking to approved source-based historical claims, historical entities/objects, and asset revisions. Enforced strict validation preventing unpublished, unreviewed, needs_source, or disputed claims from being bound to hotspots. Updated the frontend ArtDetailStudioClient and backend DTOs/services.

invariants_enforced.claim_and_entity_persistence: ImperialMediaHotspot model and database schema updated with claim_id, entity_id, and asset_revision columns, foreign key references, and indexes.
invariants_enforced.hotspot_claim_publication_gate: Hotspots can only bind historical claims whose verification_status is in eligible set ('expert_verified', 'editor_reviewed', 'verified', 'published'). Unpublished, draft, unreviewed, needs_source, or rejected claims fail with HTTP 422 HOTSPOT_CLAIM_UNPUBLISHED_OR_INVALID.
invariants_enforced.hotspot_claim_dispute_gate: Historical claims with confidence='disputed' or 'contested' cannot be bound to hotspots (fails with HTTP 422 HOTSPOT_CLAIM_DISPUTED).
invariants_enforced.hotspot_claim_entity_alignment: If both entity_id and claim_id are provided, the claim's entity_id must match the provided entity_id (fails with HTTP 422 HOTSPOT_CLAIM_ENTITY_MISMATCH).
invariants_enforced.asset_revision_consistency: Hotspots track asset_revision matching or inheriting the parent learning media asset revision.
invariants_enforced.frontend_studio_binding_ui: ArtDetailStudioClient.tsx provides input controls for claim_id, entity_id, and asset_revision, persisting them via saveMediaHotspot.

changes.description: Additive Alembic migration adding claim_id, entity_id, asset_revision columns and indexes to imperial_media_hotspots.
Added claim_id, entity_id, asset_revision mapped columns and relationships (claim, entity) to ImperialMediaHotspot.
Added claim_id, entity_id, and asset_revision to ImperialMediaHotspotBase, ImperialMediaHotspotCreate, and ImperialMediaHotspotUpdate schemas.
Added _validate_hotspot_claim_and_entity check in create_media_hotspot and update_media_hotspot, enforcing valid claim verification statuses, dispute rejection, and entity alignment.
Added claim_id, entity_id, and asset_revision fields to ImperialMediaHotspot interface.
Included claim_id, entity_id, and asset_revision in saveMediaHotspot payload handling and fallback.
Added claim_id, entity_id, and asset_revision binding inputs to the Hotspot Inspector and passed them in handleSave.
Created comprehensive test suite verifying 3D hotspot coordinates persistence, claim and entity linkage, asset revision tracking, and negative abuse prevention.

test_details.name: test_positive_persist_3d_hotspot_linked_to_approved_claim_and_entity
test_details.assertion: Verifies 3D hotspot coordinates persist cleanly when bound to an approved claim, entity, and asset revision.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_hotspot_cannot_bind_unpublished_or_unreviewed_claim
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse: Hotspot cannot bind unreviewed, needs_source, or draft historical claim.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_hotspot_cannot_bind_disputed_claim
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse: Hotspot cannot bind disputed or contested claim.

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_hotspot_claim_entity_mismatch_rejected
test_details.assertion: Negative abuse: Hotspot specifying mismatched entity_id and claim is rejected.

test_details.name: test_hotspot_patch_binding_update_and_validation
test_details.assertion: Verifies patching an existing hotspot to bind claim and entity enforces the same strict validation gates.

test_details.name: test_hotspot_binding_nonexistent_ids_return_404
test_details.assertion: Non-existent claim or entity IDs return 404 errors.
